observed_pattern.description: Production artifact emission is concentrated in scripts/run_*.py entry points that write under out/. Other modules are expected to remain non-writing or advisory.

evidence.structural: Hundreds of scripts under scripts/ with run_*.py naming; many set OUT_PATH or write under out/. Code search finds 400+ references to out/ under scripts/.
evidence.negative_examples: Some scripts explicitly document that they do NOT write to out/ (e.g. demo_safe_status.py, build_aal_viz_operator_action_packets.py).
evidence.search_notes: No sole-writer / prohibited-import / write-path gate strings located in code search of docs or scripts.

gap.description: Pattern is observed and culturally enforced via docs + review, but not yet machine-checked in fast-CI.
gap.risk: Accidental production writes from non-authorized modules remain possible given the large script surface.

proposed_lightweight_gate.name: sole_writer_or_write_path_allowlist_check
proposed_lightweight_gate.description: Add a lightweight static or unit check that can later be included in run_fast_ci.py.
options: Allow-list of modules permitted to write under out/ (initially scripts/run_*.py family + explicitly attested writers)
AST or simple path-heuristic scan that flags non-allowlisted modules performing writes to out/
Import-boundary test that prevents core modules from importing production write helpers except through authorized runners
proposed_lightweight_gate.promotion_path: Start as advisory warning in CI; promote to fail-closed once allow-list is stable and false-positive rate is acceptable.

neon_genie_note: Neon Genie remains advisory / allow-listed only; must not gain production write or governance control paths.
next_actions: Expand Interface Registry with next-tier surfaces (contracts/receipts/repo_execution_receipt.v1 and related)
Optionally implement the advisory gate in a later PR
Close RISK-006 with live validation when ready
notes: Supports Workstream 1 action 'Tighten sole-writer and prohibited-import evidence'. No runtime behavior changed in this increment.
